verdict.rationale: The platform repo is published on GitHub under FSL-1.1-ALv2 (source-available, with the catalog under Apache 2.0). A community evaluator describes Metorial as 'fully open source (not just the client)', and another praises its MCP containers being available separately, so self-hosting the core code appears possible. However, the docs present Metorial only as a hosted service (dashboard API keys, Metorial-hosted servers) and nothing documents a self-hosted deployment path. The FSL license also falls short of fully open source. Missing for 10: documented self-hosting/deployment guide, hands-on reports of running a self-hosted instance, clarity on whether the self-hosted build matches the hosted features.
